scope: Static and executable verification that local and advanced product paths use source-backed canonical retrieval without backend semantic guidance
findings: LLM router plans with a source-backed mission enter SourceBackedAgentV2 when native tool support is available.
SourceBackedRouterPlanAdapter sets sourceBackedCanonical=true for search and multi-search requests.
Canonical backend responses omit Guidance and SelectionHints while preserving document, revision, source hash, chunk and exact query identity through EvidenceBundle.
The no-LLM search-only fallback remains a separate legacy path and is outside the local-LLM plus advanced-provider contract currently under validation.

fullClientRelease.skippedReason: Opt-in live canonical vertical probe was not executed.

postgresBackend.interpretation: Includes the advanced tool gateway canonical retrieval integration test.

knownLimitations: This assessment proves routing and evidence identity mechanics, not semantic retrieval quality or answer quality.
The opt-in live client probe, WinUI source-card inspection and advanced-provider campaign remain pending.
The separate LLM-disabled search-only fallback still uses the legacy response contract.
